Hong Kong Sixes winners list: Year-wise champions and runners-up from 1992 to 2025
 Full Hong Kong Sixes winners list from 1992 to 2025, with runners-up and titles by team. Pakistan lead as the 2026 edition begins October 30.

 India will meet defending champion Pakistan in its Hong Kong Sixes campaign opener.
 India will meet defending champion Pakistan in its Hong Kong Sixes campaign opener.
 Pakistan, the most successful team in Hong Kong Sixes history, opens the defence of its title on Friday as the 22nd edition of the six-a-side tournament gets under way at the Tin Kwong Road Recreation Ground.
 Led by Abbas Afridi, the player of the tournament last year, Pakistan is chasing a record-extending seventh crown after beating Kuwait by 43 runs in the 2025 final.
 It meets India, led by Krunal Pandya and winner only once, in 2005, in the pick of the opening-day fixtures. Twelve teams are in the field across three days of action, with England and South Africa, five titles apiece, among those hoping to close the gap on Pakistan.

 Year-wise breakdown of title winners
 Pakistan - win: 1992, 1997, 2001, 2002, 2011, 2025 | runner-up: 2003, 2006, 2010, 2012, 2017, 2024
 England - win: 1993, 1994, 2003, 2004, 2008 | runner-up: 1995, 1997, 2002, 2011
 South Africa - win: 1995, 2006, 2009, 2012, 2017 | runner-up: 2001
 Sri Lanka - win: 2007, 2024 | runner-up: 1993, 2004
 India - win: 2005 | runner-up: 1992, 1996
 Australia - win: 2010 | runner-up: 1994, 2008
 West Indies - win: 1996 | runner-up: 2005
 All Stars - win: none | runner-up: 2007
 Hong Kong - win: none | runner-up: 2009
 Kuwait - win: none | runner-up: 2025
